rule: This file defines portable packet shapes for private learner evidence and Chat-generated next-day Challenges. It stores no personal learner state and is not lexical semantic authority.

event_fields.word: Optional display spelling; never semantic authority.
event_fields.target_kind: core | sense | collocation | construction | phrase | relation | word_feel | productive_need
event_fields.target_id: Stable Current subobject identity when one exists, such as sense_id, collocation_id, fact_id, or relation_id.
event_fields.target_locator: Owner-local deterministic locator only when no stable subobject id exists.
event_fields.source: depth_plus | challenge | reconstruction | reading | cloze | translation | writing | blind_probe
event_fields.outcome: ADDED | CORRECT | WRONG | SLOW | AGAIN | QUESTION_ISSUE | SEMANTIC_ISSUE
event_fields.challenge_id: Optional Challenge identity when the event came from a generated Challenge.
event_fields.correct_key: Optional correct spatial answer key; include only after the learner has answered.
event_fields.question_trace: Optional minimal prompt/options trace when needed to diagnose a wrong judgment or defective generated question.
event_fields.note: Optional learner/Chat note for QUESTION_ISSUE or SEMANTIC_ISSUE; not required for ordinary events.

rules: Do not duplicate whole lexical definitions when stable Current owner identities are sufficient.
Every explicit +, WRONG, AGAIN, repeated failure, QUESTION_ISSUE, or SEMANTIC_ISSUE must be consumed by next-day Chat compilation.
A defective generated question is not learner failure.
Return Packet is private learner evidence and must not be committed as shared Current content.

challenge_fields.target_kind: core | sense | collocation | construction | phrase | relation | word_feel | productive_need
challenge_fields.target_id: Stable Current subobject identity when available.
challenge_fields.target_locator: Owner-local locator only when no stable subobject id exists.
challenge_fields.source_evidence: Why this target is being challenged: prior +, wrong, slow/fuzzy, repeated failure, module failure, or blind probe.
challenge_fields.question_type: spatial_choice for v1; later versions may add other low-friction forms.
challenge_fields.stem: Generated challenge prompt/context. Must not leak protected unseen true-exam/TPO source material.
challenge_fields.options: Array of 2-4 objects with key in left | up | right | down and learner-visible text.
challenge_fields.correct_key: One spatial key present in options.
challenge_fields.repair: Optional smallest-sufficient repair shown only after failure.
challenge_fields.reconstruction: Optional one same-session reconstruction item after failure; same spatial-choice shape without recursive repair chains.

rules: Challenge content may be freely generated from valid Current lexical semantics and relations.
Do not require one pre-authored question per lexical object.
Do not use unattempted true-exam, TPO, or other held-out unseen source sentences as ordinary generated Challenge material.
Two-choice items should normally use left/right; three- and four-choice items use consistent spatial arrow positions.
Arrow choice submits immediately; ordinary selection does not require a second Enter confirmation.
Wrong/Again targets must remain represented in the next Return Packet even when same-session reconstruction succeeds.
Challenge Packet is private learner material generated for a study day and must not become lexical semantic authority.

chat_compile_order: older unresolved high-value repair targets when still useful
small residual blind-probe layer only after repair obligations
no_review_debt_rule: If repair load is high, reduce blind probes and new Depth volume before creating an automatic overdue backlog. Missed calendar days recompile from unresolved evidence rather than manufacturing due-card debt.
